text: {"label":"Behavioral Accounts of Mind and Thought","definition":"Conceptual and experimental behavior-analytic treatments of mentalistic phenomena such as theory of mind, consciousness, thinking, self-talk, perspective taking, implicit cognition, and self-referential thoughts.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on mind, consciousness, and private thought, not creativity and complex behavior, derived relational responding as such, or the behavior and culture of science."}
